status: prospective; synthetic tests only, no neural-offset competition fit performed
hypothesis: A neural correction to a strong GLM may learn complementary interactions more efficiently than the previous standalone MLP or TabM. This is an independently trained residual network, not a retrained public prediction stream.

architecture.input: R13 GLM preprocessing: BPE+frequency+16 hierarchical pooled logits; approximately207 dimensions, actual width recorded per stage
architecture.network: input -> Linear256 -> SiLU -> Dropout0.1 -> Linear256 -> SiLU -> Dropout0.1 -> Linear1
architecture.head: Last-layer weight and bias zero initially; combined initial predictor equals GLM after float32 margin conversion
architecture.objective: Unweighted mean BCEWithLogits on the summed margin, AdamW0.001/weight_decay0.0001, gradient norm clip1.0
architecture.precision: Encoded neural inputs, GLM margin and neural weights float32; no claim of bit identity to standalone float64 GLM. Saved prediction reload tolerance1e-6.

validation: Exploratory full-data StratifiedKFold5/42, same699960 OOF IDs/labels/folds as R10. Within each outer-training fold, reserve15% stratified at seed42. Fit inner preprocessing, target maps, frequency, scaling, pooled maps and GLM using inner-training rows only. Use exactly that cross-fitted matrix for the inner GLM and neural residual. Choose epoch E<=40 with inner AUC/patience6 and minimum increment1e-6. Discard preprocessing, GLM, network and optimizer; fit all of them anew on the complete outer-training fold for exactly E epochs. Outer validation labels are absent from the model API. No original augmentation, public-score selection or independent holdout.
convergence: Require both GLMs to finish without ConvergenceWarning and before the solver cap. Abort and report failure instead of treating a numeric failure as a model score. Persist inner/outer convergence and epoch history separately.

fixed_comparisons.selection: Report all four shares; highest pooled OOF among eligible shares. No architecture, optimizer, dropout or weight sweep after observing outcomes.

promotion_rule: Exceed R10 pooled hybrid OOF by strictly more than0.0001 and improve at least4/5 folds. Before submitting also exceed any already-selected qualifying candidate from other new rounds. At most one submission after independent source/data/config/ID/fold/label/formula and five real checkpoint reload audits. If no share passes, record the result and do not submit; no exception.
cost: Five inner selections plus five fresh outer neural fits and10 GLM/preprocessing fits. CPU fixed so the separate R12 GPU work can continue. A fabricated207-input/4-thread benchmark processed40960 rows in0.5165s; that is not a full-data runtime or quality claim. No paid compute.
training_gate: Publish this plan, reviewed implementation and passing tests before any competition-data neural fit. Run a clean isolated pinned worktree, with source unchanged during training.
